text:
Maya: Quick pulse check  who wants to join the office bracket and/or just come to the big watch on Friday? Seats limited.
Diego: In for both. bribing coworkers with empanadas. :taco:
Priya: I'll join the bracket but only if I can veto songs on the speaker playlist. chaotic energy only on my watch. :headphones:
Hector: Im 50/50. will probably show up for halftime fantasy trades. also someone owes me last season's trophy.
Maya: Tie-breaker is combined final score, same as last time. $10 buy-in for bracket, cash or Venmo to @Maya.
Priya: can we do a group photo for the trophy handoff? I want it for my desk.
Diego: Also need a volunteer for pickup. I can swing by the pizza place if @Hector picks up wings.
Hector: Yup I can grab wings. ETA 6pm. what sizes?
Maya: Large veggie + 2 pepperoni + wings (hot and mild). anyone want gluten-free?
Priya: gluten-free slice please.
Diego: btw tiny rule change: bench players count if they score in OT. Sound good?
Hector: fine by me. well probably regret it.
ops-bot: Reminder: Conference Room B is booked at 6:30pm. Please return chairs by 9pm. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Great. I'll post the signup sheet and final team list in #random by 3pm.
Priya: bringing a bluetooth speaker and some LED lights for vibes.
Diego: Ill bring the camera for the trophy photo.
Hector: If someone brings a HDMI adapter, game on.
Maya: @team anyone want to livestream to remote folks? we can set up a Zoom if so.
Priya: yes pls, my cousin wants to watch and roast my picks.
Maya: Cool. I'll set up Zoom and share link after roster closes. GL everyone :crossed_fingers:
Diego: :muscle:
Hector: :trophy:
